prompts.name: sign
prompts.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather. Production Factorio CAST-SHADOW-ONLY texture atlas. Image 1 is four exact tall pole-sign sprites and their positions. Image 2 is the vanilla Factorio LIGHTING reference: copy the small electric pole's horizontal, ground-flattened shadow physics. Do not copy its colored sprite.
Return a genuine transparent PNG, black shadows ONLY, no objects/floor/grid/text/checkerboard. Preserve Image 1's square 2x2 layout, north/east/south/west in TL/TR/BL/BR. Source canvas 768x768, each cell 384x384. In EACH cell the sign feet contact the ground approximately at (96,272) (east-facing contact x=76; west-facing x=116). Keep those EXACT foot contact locations. Shadow projects EAST/RIGHT, almost horizontally, fixed light for all rotations.
Critical physics: a tall vertical post's HEIGHT becomes HORIZONTAL LENGTH in its ground shadow. Draw exactly ONE small footing shadow at the LEFT contact point. From it a thin, roughly horizontal, long pole shadow runs right for about 200 source pixels. At the far end draw ONLY a ground-flattened sign-board/cap/fittings silhouette, a LOW WIDE RECTANGLE/TRAPEZOID approximately 50-80px wide and 15-35px tall. There MUST NOT be a second upright sign or duplicate foot base at the far end. No vertical pole at the shadow's tip. The board silhouette lies FLAT ON THE GROUND like the vanilla pole's insulator silhouette. The complete ground cast stays within a narrow band roughly y=252..300 in each cell, despite the source object extending y=50..296 upward. The four facing-specific board geometries must correspond to their objects, but NEVER draw the upright colored objects as black silhouettes.
All nontransparent RGB pure black, solid interiors and crisp antialiased edges. Start the shadow directly under its original feet, do not move the source contact point upward. All quadrants retain their original ground registration, no centering each shadow separately.

prompts.name: multisign
prompts.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather. Asset type: production Factorio cast-shadow-only sprite layer. Image 1 is the exact object/placement reference, Image 2 is ONLY the native Factorio lighting reference (pole and furnace cast shadows). Generate the CAST SHADOWS ONLY of the objects in Image 1. REMOVE all colored objects and output only their projected black ground shadows, on a genuinely transparent alpha=0 background. No backdrop, floor, checkerboard, labels, light gray rectangle, object render, highlights, arrows drawn inside shadows, or gradients. All visible shadow RGB must be pure black, opaque silhouette interiors with only a tiny antialiased edge; the game supplies final shadow opacity. Match the vanilla reference: fixed sun from screen LEFT, casting predominantly screen RIGHT/east, virtually horizontal, only slight perspective spreading. Shadows must lie flat on the ground; do NOT simply fill the tall upright sprite black. Do NOT rotate the light source when rotating an object. Preserve Image 1's EXACT canvas layout, relative object scales, projected ground contact/feet positions and quadrant positions. Each shadow begins under the precise feet/base of its corresponding source object. Leave ample transparent margins. Image 1 is a 768x768 atlas, four 384x384 cells: top left north-facing flat T hub, top right east-facing, bottom left south-facing, bottom right west-facing. Each world ground origin is x=96,y=272 in its cell. This apparatus is FLAT and very LOW on the ground, not a tall signpost. Its cast shadow is SHORT and CLOSE to its footprint: T-arm silhouettes, circular hub and brass sockets shadow underneath, with only roughly 10-16 source pixels of eastward offset at the highest hub, and 3-8 pixels at low arms. Keep each exact three-arm orientation, do not invent an extra arm or a pole. No elongated projection. Return only four low-profile black ground shadows, each overlapping its original object's footprint so the object will cover most of the shadow.
